voice.name: Borg
voice.note: The user's own voice, designed on the site for the cube Mothership: many voices speaking as one.
voice.description: A voice of the many: an evil, serious, robotic adult male chorus, as if a whole collective speaks at once, cold and unhurried.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi tractor beam locking on from a huge alien ship overhead: a deep humming energy beam switching on, a rising electric whir that settles into a steady resonant throb, cold and mechanical, no explosion, no gunfire, outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Sci-fi matter absorption: a vehicle dissolving into light and drawn up into a ship overhead, a shimmering electric crackle rising quickly in pitch into a soft deep whoosh and a hollow mechanical thump, no explosion, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Enormous alien cube spaceship hovering overhead and drifting: a very deep low droning engine hum with slow mechanical pulses and a faint metallic groan, heavy and ominous, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Enormous alien cube spaceship destroyed in the air: deep chained energy explosions ripping through a huge metal structure, a long metallic groan, crackling electric arcs, and a massive crash on the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
